parameters.jsonBody:
={{ { model: 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile', temperature: 0.2, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You are a customer-support triage assistant for CloudNote. Return valid JSON only with keys category (billing, technical, account_access, feature_request, legal_or_security, other), priority (low, medium, high, urgent), sentiment, summary, recommendedAction, needsHumanReview (boolean). Treat legal threats, security incidents, payment disputes, and requests involving sensitive data as needsHumanReview=true." }, { role: 'user', content: 'Ticket ID: ' + $json.ticket.ticketId + '
Subject: ' + $json.ticket.subject + '
Message: ' + $json.ticket.message + '
Plan: ' + $json.ticket.plan } ] } }}

={{ { model: 'llama-3.1-8b-instant', temperature: 0.2, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You write concise, empathetic customer support replies for CloudNote. Do not claim an action was completed unless confirmed. Never ask for passwords, OTPs, or full payment details. Return JSON only: {\"draftReply\":\"...\"}." }, { role: 'user', content: 'Ticket: ' + JSON.stringify($('Parse Triage').item.json.ticket) + '\nTriage: ' + JSON.stringify($('Parse Triage').item.json.triage) + '\nWrite a helpful customer reply. If details are missing, explain the next safe step.' } ] } }}

={{ { model: 'llama-3.1-8b-instant', temperature: 0.2, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You write concise internal-only support notes for CloudNote agents. Include category, priority, likely next action, and any risks. Do not include a customer-facing greeting. Return JSON only: {\"internalNote\":\"...\"}." }, { role: 'user', content: 'Ticket: ' + JSON.stringify($('Parse Triage').item.json.ticket) + '\nTriage: ' + JSON.stringify($('Parse Triage').item.json.triage) } ] } }}

={{ { model: 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile', temperature: 0.2, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You are a strict quality and safety reviewer for customer-support replies. Check accuracy, empathy, privacy, unsupported promises, and whether legal/security/payment-risk cases are routed to a human. Return JSON only: {"approved":true|false,"reason":"...","riskFlags":[],"revisedReplyNeeded":true|false}. Set approved=false if unsafe, misleading, too vague, or needs human handling." }, { role: 'user', content: 'Ticket: ' + JSON.stringify($('Parse Triage').item.json.ticket) + '
Triage: ' + JSON.stringify($('Parse Triage').item.json.triage) + '
Draft reply: ' + $json.draftReply + '
Internal note: ' + $json.internalNote } ] } }}

={{ { model: 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile', temperature: 0.2, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You revise customer support replies based on reviewer feedback. Preserve accurate information, remove unsafe claims, be empathetic, and do not request passwords or OTPs. Return JSON only: {"revisedReply":"..."}." }, { role: 'user', content: 'Ticket: ' + JSON.stringify($json.ticket) + '
Original draft: ' + $json.draftReply + '
Review feedback: ' + JSON.stringify($json.review) + '
Revise the reply based on this feedback.' } ] } }}

={{ { model: 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile', temperature: 0.2, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You are a strict safety reviewer for customer-support replies. Approve only if the revised reply is accurate, empathetic, privacy-safe, makes no unsupported promises, and is appropriate to send. Return JSON only: {"approved":true|false,"reason":"...","riskFlags":[]}." }, { role: 'user', content: 'Ticket: ' + JSON.stringify($json.ticket) + '
Triage: ' + JSON.stringify($json.triage) + '
Revised reply: ' + $json.draftReply + '
Previous review: ' + JSON.stringify($json.review) } ] } }}
